mf_newforms.description: Classical holomorphic newforms on Gamma_0(N). Each row is a Galois orbit.

columns.label: text — Unique label N.k.c.x, e.g. '11.2.a.a'.
columns.space_label: text — Label of the parent newspace N.k.c.
columns.hecke_orbit: integer — Orbit index within the newspace.
columns.dim: integer — Dimension of Galois orbit over Q.
columns.relative_dim: integer — Dimension over the character field.
columns.is_polredabs: boolean — Whether the field polynomial is polredabs-reduced.
columns.is_maximal: boolean — Whether this is the maximal Hecke orbit.
columns.is_largest: boolean — Whether this is the largest Hecke orbit.
columns.nf_label: text — LMFDB label of Hecke field as number field. Null for dim=1.
columns.trace_hash: bigint — Hash of first 1000 Hecke traces.
columns.analytic_rank: smallint — Order of vanishing of L(s,f) at central point.
columns.analytic_rank_proved: boolean — Whether analytic rank is rigorously proved.
columns.is_self_dual: boolean — Whether form is isomorphic to its dual.
columns.is_self_twist: boolean — Whether form is a self-twist.
columns.is_cm: boolean — Whether the form has CM.
columns.is_rm: boolean — Whether the form has RM.
columns.has_non_self_twist: smallint — 1 if a character twist gives a non-isomorphic form.
columns.cm_discs: integer[] — Negative discriminants D s.t. form has CM by Q(sqrt(D)).
columns.rm_discs: integer[] — Positive discriminants D s.t. form has RM.
columns.minimal_twist: text — Label of the twist-minimal form.
columns.char_orbit_label: text — Galois orbit of the character as a letter; 'a' = trivial. NOT char_label.
columns.char_orbit_index: smallint — Integer index of character orbit; 1 = trivial.
columns.char_order: integer — Order of chi; 1 = trivial, 2 = real/quadratic.
columns.char_conductor: integer — Conductor of chi; 1 for trivial character.
columns.char_is_real: boolean — Whether chi takes only real values.
columns.char_is_minimal: boolean — Whether the character is minimal.
columns.char_parity: smallint — Parity of chi: +1 even, -1 odd.
columns.char_values: jsonb — Values of character on generators.
columns.conrey_index: integer — Conrey index n; full label = level.n.
columns.prim_orbit_index: smallint — Orbit index of the primitive character.
columns.weight_parity: smallint — Parity of weight: +1 if k even, -1 if k odd.
columns.Nk2: integer — Product N*k^2; internal sort key.
columns.atkin_lehner_string: text — String of +/- for AL eigenvalues.
columns.field_poly: numeric[] — Coefficients of minimal polynomial of Hecke field.
columns.field_disc: numeric — Discriminant of Hecke field. 1 for dim=1.
columns.field_poly_is_cyclotomic: boolean — Whether Hecke field is cyclotomic.
columns.field_poly_is_real_cyclotomic: boolean — Whether Hecke field is real cyclotomic.
columns.field_poly_root_of_unity: integer — Root of unity order if field is cyclotomic.
columns.hecke_ring_index: numeric — Index of Hecke ring in full ring of integers.
columns.hecke_ring_index_factorization: numeric[] — Factorization of Hecke ring index.
columns.hecke_ring_generator_nbound: integer — Bound on Hecke ring generator.
columns.projective_image: text — Projective image of the Galois representation.
columns.projective_field_label: text — LMFDB label of projective field.
columns.artin_degree: integer — Degree of Artin representation for weight-1 forms.
columns.artin_image: text — Artin image label for weight-1 forms.
columns.artin_field_label: text — LMFDB label of Artin field.
columns.traces: numeric[] — Hecke traces a_n for n=1..1000.
columns.trace_display: numeric[] — First few Hecke traces for display.
columns.trace_moments: numeric[] — Moments of Hecke trace distribution.
columns.trace_zratio: numeric — Zero ratio statistic for traces.
columns.related_objects: text[] — Labels of related LMFDB objects.
columns.level_is_prime_power: boolean — Whether N is a prime power.
columns.level_is_prime_square: boolean — Whether N is a prime square.
columns.level_is_square: boolean — Whether N is a perfect square.
columns.level_is_powerful: boolean — Whether N is powerful (every prime divides to at least the second power).

mf_newspaces.description: Newspaces S_k^new(N, chi). Each row is a (level, weight, character orbit) triple.

columns.label: text — Label N.k.c, e.g. '11.2.a'.
columns.char_orbit_label: text — Character orbit label; 'a' = trivial. NOT char_label.
columns.char_values: jsonb — Values of character on generators.
columns.prim_orbit_index: smallint — Orbit index of the primitive character.
columns.dim: integer — Total dimension of new subspace over all Galois orbits.
columns.relative_dim: integer — Dimension relative to character field.
columns.ALdims_old: integer[] — AL eigenspace dimensions for old subspace.
columns.ALdims_eis_new: integer[] — AL eigenspace dimensions for new Eisenstein subspace.
columns.ALdims_eis_old: integer[] — AL eigenspace dimensions for old Eisenstein subspace.
columns.hecke_orbit_dims: integer[] — Dimensions of each Galois orbit.
columns.hecke_cutter_primes: integer[] — Primes used as Hecke cutters.
columns.traces: numeric[] — Hecke traces for the space.
columns.trace_display: numeric[] — First few traces for display.
columns.level_is_prime_power: boolean — Whether N is a prime power.
columns.level_is_prime_square: boolean — Whether N is a prime square.
columns.level_is_square: boolean — Whether N is a perfect square.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label.
columns.Lhash: text — Hash identifier for the L-function.
columns.origin: text — LMFDB URL of the source object.
columns.degree: smallint — Degree d (number of Gamma factors).
columns.motivic_weight: smallint — Motivic weight w; central point at s=(w+1)/2. For weight-k newform: w=k-1.
columns.root_number: text — Sign epsilon in functional equation (stored as text).
columns.root_angle: float — Argument of root number in [0,1).
columns.order_of_vanishing: smallint — Order of vanishing at central point (analytic rank).
columns.self_dual: boolean — Whether L(s) equals its own dual.
columns.symmetry_type: text — Katz-Sarnak symmetry type: unitary, symplectic, orthogonal, SO(even), SO(odd).
columns.positive_zeros: jsonb — Imaginary parts of nontrivial zeros (positive, analytic normalization).
columns.z1: numeric — Imaginary part of first zero.
columns.z2: numeric — Imaginary part of second zero.
columns.z3: numeric — Imaginary part of third zero.
columns.dirichlet_coefficients: jsonb — First few Dirichlet coefficients a_n.
columns.euler_factors: jsonb — Euler factors at good primes.
columns.bad_lfactors: jsonb — Local L-factors at bad primes.
columns.mu_real: smallint[] — Real parts of mu Gamma parameters.
columns.mu_imag: numeric[] — Imaginary parts of mu Gamma parameters.
columns.nu_real_doubled: smallint[] — Doubled real parts of nu Gamma parameters.
columns.nu_imag: numeric[] — Imaginary parts of nu Gamma parameters.
columns.leading_term: text — Leading term at central point.

lfunc_instances.description: Links from LMFDB objects to their L-functions.

columns.label: text — L-function label (foreign key into lfunc_lfunctions).
columns.Lhash: text — Hash identifier (join key into lfunc_lfunctions.Lhash).
columns.Lhash_array: text[] — Array of Lhash values for products.
columns.type: text — Source object type: CMF, EC, G2C, NF, DIR, Artin.
columns.url: text — LMFDB URL of the source object.

ec_curvedata.description: Elliptic curves over Q. Primary key is lmfdb_label.

columns.lmfdb_label: text — PRIMARY KEY. LMFDB label N.isoN, e.g. '11.a1'. Use this for all filters.
columns.Ciso: text — Cremona isogeny class label, e.g. '11a'.
columns.Cnumber: smallint — Cremona curve number within isogeny class.
columns.lmfdb_iso: text — LMFDB isogeny class label, e.g. '11.a'.
columns.lmfdb_number: smallint — LMFDB curve number within isogeny class.
columns.cm: smallint — 0 if no CM; else negative fundamental discriminant of CM field.
columns.torsion: smallint — Order of E(Q)_tors. NOTE: column is 'torsion', NOT 'torsion_order'.
columns.torsion_structure: smallint[] — Torsion subgroup structure, e.g. [2,4] for Z/2 x Z/4.
columns.num_bad_primes: smallint — Number of primes of bad reduction.
columns.isogeny_degrees: smallint[] — Degrees of isogenies from E in its class.
columns.class_size: smallint — Number of curves in isogeny class.
columns.nonmax_primes: smallint[] — Primes l for which mod-l rep is non-maximal.
columns.modell_images: text[] — Images of mod-l Galois representations.
columns.elladic_images: text[] — Images of l-adic Galois representations.
columns.modm_images: text[] — Images of mod-m Galois representations.
columns.degree: bigint — Degree of the modular parametrization.
columns.optimality: smallint — Whether curve is the optimal Cremona model.
columns.semistable: boolean — Whether E has semistable reduction everywhere.
columns.potential_good_reduction: boolean — Whether E has potential good reduction.
columns.squarefree_disc: boolean — Whether the discriminant is squarefree.
columns.min_quad_twist_ainvs: numeric[] — Weierstrass coefficients of minimal quadratic twist.
columns.min_quad_twist_disc: smallint — Discriminant of minimal quadratic twist.
columns.abc_quality: float — ABC quality of the curve.

ec_mwbsd.description: Mordell-Weil and BSD data for elliptic curves over Q.

columns.lmfdb_label: text — LMFDB label (foreign key into ec_curvedata).
columns.gens: numeric[] — Mordell-Weil generators as encoded coordinates.
columns.heights: numeric[] — Neron-Tate canonical heights of generators.
columns.rank_bounds: smallint[] — Lower and upper bounds on rank.
columns.real_period: numeric — Real period Omega (stored as numeric, not jsonb).
columns.sha_an: numeric — Analytic |Sha| (stored as numeric, not jsonb).
columns.tamagawa_product: integer — Product of Tamagawa numbers over bad primes.
columns.area: numeric — Area of the fundamental domain.

ec_localdata.description: Local reduction data for elliptic curves at each bad prime.

columns.prime: integer — Prime p of bad reduction.
columns.root_number: smallint — Local root number at p.
columns.kodaira_symbol: smallint — Kodaira symbol encoded as integer.
columns.conductor_valuation: smallint — Valuation of conductor at p.
columns.discriminant_valuation: smallint — Valuation of minimal discriminant at p.
columns.j_denominator_valuation: smallint — Valuation of j-invariant denominator at p.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label d.r2.disc.n, e.g. '2.0.3.1' for Q(sqrt(-3)).
columns.r2: smallint — Number of complex place pairs. r1 = degree - 2*r2.
columns.iso_number: smallint — Isomorphism class number within label family.
columns.cm: boolean — Whether K is a CM field.
columns.galt: integer — Galois group index in the transitive groups list.
columns.galois_label: text — Galois group label as transitive subgroup of S_d, e.g. '4T3'.
columns.class_group: jsonb — Invariants of the class group.
columns.narrow_class_group: bigint[] — Invariants of the narrow class group.
columns.relative_class_number: numeric — Relative class number (for CM fields).
columns.coeffs: numeric[] — Defining polynomial coefficients, lowest degree first.
columns.torsion_order: smallint — Order of torsion subgroup of units.
columns.unit_signature_rank: smallint — Rank of unit signature map.
columns.monogenic: smallint — Whether ring of integers is monogenic (1=yes, 0=no, -1=unknown).
columns.index: integer — Index of the field within its degree and discriminant class.
columns.is_minimal_sibling: boolean — Whether this is the minimal sibling field.
columns.minimal_sibling: numeric[] — Polynomial of minimal sibling field.
columns.galois_disc_exponents: numeric[] — Exponents in discriminant of Galois closure.
columns.maximal_cm_subfield: numeric[] — Polynomial of maximal CM subfield.
columns.local_algs: text[] — Local algebra descriptions at ramified primes.
columns.embeddings_gen_real: float[] — Real parts of embeddings of the generator.
columns.embeddings_gen_imag: float[] — Imaginary parts of embeddings of the generator.
columns.used_grh: boolean — Whether GRH was assumed in computations.
columns.maxp: numeric — Largest prime for which local data is stored.

char_dirichlet.description: Dirichlet characters chi: (Z/qZ)* -> C*. NOTE: 'order' is a reserved SQL keyword — always quote it as "order" in queries.

columns.label: text — Conrey label q.n, e.g. '5.2'.
columns.orbit: integer — Orbit index within the modulus.
columns.primitive_orbit: integer — Orbit index of the primitive character inducing chi.
columns.order: integer — Order of chi; 1=trivial, 2=real/quadratic. RESERVED KEYWORD: always quote as "order" in SQL.
columns.first: integer — First Conrey index in the orbit.
columns.last: integer — Last Conrey index in the orbit.
columns.is_real: boolean — Whether chi takes only real values.

g2c_curves.description: Genus-2 curves over Q. NOTE: conductor column is named 'cond', not 'conductor'.

columns.label: text — LMFDB label.
columns.cond: bigint — Conductor of J(C). NOTE: column is 'cond', NOT 'conductor'.
columns.abs_disc: bigint — Absolute discriminant of the curve model.
columns.eqn: text — Equation of the hyperelliptic model y^2 = f(x).
columns.analytic_rank_proved: boolean — Whether analytic rank is proved.
columns.mw_rank_proved: boolean — Whether MW rank is proved.
columns.torsion_order: smallint — Order of torsion subgroup of J(Q).
columns.end_alg: text — Endomorphism algebra End^0(J) over Q: Q, QxQ, CM, RM, M_2(Q).
columns.is_gl2_type: boolean — Whether J is of GL_2-type.
columns.is_simple_base: boolean — Whether J is simple over Q.
columns.is_simple_geom: boolean — Whether J is geometrically simple.
columns.globally_solvable: smallint — Whether C is everywhere locally solvable.
columns.locally_solvable: boolean — Whether C is locally solvable at all places.
columns.has_square_sha: boolean — Whether |Sha| is a perfect square.
columns.hasse_weil_proved: boolean — Whether the Hasse-Weil conjecture is proved.
columns.bad_lfactors: text — Local L-factors at bad primes.
columns.non_maximal_primes: integer[] — Primes where mod-l rep is non-maximal.
columns.non_solvable_places: jsonb — Places where curve is not solvable.
columns.modell_images: text[] — Images of mod-l Galois representations.
columns.num_rat_pts: smallint — Number of known rational points on C.
columns.num_rat_wpts: smallint — Number of rational Weierstrass points.
columns.geom_aut_grp_id: text — Geometric automorphism group GAP id.
columns.geom_aut_grp_tex: text — Geometric automorphism group LaTeX name.
